d:
Watch Mersalaayitten from ‘I’ a super fun number sung by Anirudh Ravichander & Neeti Mohan. A.R. Rahman gives us a fun yet massy track in this song written by Kabilan. The song features Vikram describing how he got ‘Mersal’ thanks to the gorgeous Amy Jackson.
Song Name - Mersalaayitten
Movie - I
Singer - Anirudh Ravichander & Neeti Mohan
Music - A.R. Rahman
Lyrics - Kabilan
Director - Shankar
Starring - Vikram, Amy Jackson
